navaid.name: USCGC William Tate
navaid.description: A Keeper Class coastal buoy tender with a crew of 24; responsible for servicing harbor buoys. This multi-mission vessel has a 2,000 nautical mile range and can perform search and rescue, law enforcement, homeland defense operations, and ice breaking.

navaid.name: USCGC Cleat
navaid.description: The 65' small harbor tug missions are domestic ice breaking, port security, search and rescue, and law enforcement operations on rivers and inland areas.

Marine railway consisted of two ramps used to launch submarines into the Reserve Basin. These ramps are laid on steel frames and have surfaces made of wood planks. Stacks of square timbers and blocks once served as cradles for the submarines.
